text:
anna: FYI noticing p95 regressions on dashboards after prefetch flip. looks like authz is being exercised per tile. anyone else?
jordan: confirmed on canary traces. prefetch fans out N subqueries and each hits authz. QPS spikes.
samir: logs match. duplicate identical checks for same tenant/viewer. huge duplication.
maria: recall we moved authz into renderer to keep decisions near data. we didn’t account for bulk prefetch. idea: short-lived gateway decision cache to dedupe during page load.
claire: main risk is staleness on role changes/revokes. need invalidation semantics.
tim: propose TTL 5s default + event-driven invalidation on policy revision. attach decision revision to cache entries.
ryan: memory at scale is a concern. use bounded LRU per-tenant shards, store hashed keys and minimal metadata.
samir: quick pseudo sketch:
```go
// DecisionCache: per-tenant LRU shards, TTL 5s
// Key: sha256(actor|resource|action)
// Value: {allow bool, expiry, revision}
```
config: {"authz_cache":{"enabled":true,"ttl_seconds":5,"max_entries_per_shard":5000}}
maria: ops asks for metrics: hit/miss, evictions, stale_bypass_count, and a circuit-breaker to disable cache on thrash. rollout behind feature-flaged canary.
jordan: correctness: miss => realtime eval. on policy revision event evict tenant entries or bump global revision. support forced invalidation via admin API for emergency revokes.
claire: @security can you confirm 5s staleness is acceptable for normal role changes? and can we rely on eventbus for revokes?
security: 5s acceptable for non-critical changes. for legal/compliance revokes we must support immediate invalidation via API and mark tokens; emit audit events when cache is bypassed.
engbot: perf snapshot: baseline authz upstream QPS 12k, prototype cache reduces to 3.6k (hit ~70%), median dashboard load -27%.
ryan: multi-tab consider: keys must include actor+resource+action. consider session-scoped TTL if we see cross-session collisions.
tim: store minimal Decision struct (allow/deny, expiry, revision) not full policy blob. reduces memory and GC pressure.
maria: rollout checklist: behind flag -> canary region 48h monitor -> 10% -> 50% -> full. add runbook to toggle off if incorrect allows observed.
jordan: no client changes. add unit/integration tests + e2e for policy revocation path.
anna: also scan for other N+1 authz spots (embeddings prefetch, tenant metadata). prioritize narrow scope to authz cache first.
maria: I'll draft RFC follow-up with design, config knobs, metrics, and rollout. tagging @deploy-bot for canary automation and @security for final signoff. :+1:
